basic_info.description: Spectacular Mission Creek, Bay Bridge and Ball Park views from this luxurious corner 2BR 2BA home with abundant natural light at One Mission Bay. Residence 420 is a unique open floor plan with a Juliet balcony looking right into the stunning Creek. The gorgeous kitchen features Gaggenau appliances, Vadara counter-tops, Domus & Domus cabinetry, and a custom kitchen island. The luxurious master bath features Kohler fixtures, Porcelanosa tile, double vanity, and a soak-in tub with custom glass closure. In-unit washer/dryer, Central heat and air conditioning. The resort like amenities include a Harley Pasternak designed fitness center with dry sauna, heated outdoor pool and spa, a terrace with a fire pit, cabana, barbecues, outdoor kitchen with dining area, game room and catering kitchen, a business center and library with private meeting rooms, dog wash, a reservable guest suite, and adjacent hotel and restaurant. 24-Hour lobby attendant, and One car parking.
